a.lede: The first-ever criminal case involving AI-assisted music streaming fraud has concluded, with an American citizen facing 18 months behind bars and an $8M fine.
a.title: American jailed for commanding 10,000 bots to stream his own AI-generated songs

b.lede: A North Carolina musician was sentenced to 18 months in prison for collecting more than $10 million in royalties from Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, and YouTube Music in a massive streaming royalty fraud scheme. [...]
b.title: Musician sent to prison for $10 million streaming fraud using AI bots
